request_counts_scope: Cumulative CLI commands including preserved pre-publication run and grammar recovery requests.

timestamp_value_design.109: 25 hours old, expected expired with one-day retention

capture_execution_notes: Preserved initial 28-command pre-publication run plus three grammar recovery requests; its group/filters were verified deleted and produced no custom metric data.

Second script execution used 118 commands; supplemental five read-only commands captured accepted timestamp events, complete metric-data windows, and per-minute defaults. Cumulative counts include all commands.

Original GetMetricData polls used MaxDatapoints10000 and returned PartialData with NextToken: they are not terminal empty results. Supplemental MaxDatapoints100800 queries return Complete with no NextToken. Script now uses100800 for its16-series30-hour window.

Supplemental timestamp GetLogEvents was executed while group existed; script now includes this same read. Supplemental metric queries after cleanup retrieve retained data without creating a publisher.
No formatter, linter, build, project tests, shared helper, Go, docs, or committed testdata files were modified or run.

initial_minute.correlation: One matching event contributes5; fourteen nonmatching events contribute3 each (13 in basic batch plus one same-minute timestamp event).

later_arrival_minute.correlation: Two NONMATCH_ONLY events and one UNIT_MATCH event each contribute default3.

defaults.interpretation: This run positively demonstrates per-nonmatching-event default contributions, including minutes also containing a match, rather than one fallback per minute.

timestamp_attribution.interpretation: Returned metric timestamps equal minute-rounded event timestamps and differ from recorded ingestionTime/request windows. Future-event metric points were returned before those wall-clock minutes.

unit_replacement.interpretation: Replacement unit took effect for new publication in this run; no unit conversion. Both original and replacement units remain queryable.

unresolved: JsonBad and JsonMissing metric series had no point in complete queries. Matching/admission does not prove extraction/publication; bounded absence does not establish permanent loss.
Transformed:true was admitted without a provisioned transformer but no Transformed datapoint was returned. No transformer/account-level configuration was changed or inferred.
Wrong-account selection returned no points; positive matching-account selection and emitted system dimensions were observed. No cross-account centralization was created.

The -23h event value113 was positively readable in Logs but had no metric point during this bounded run. Native expired index1 is preserved verbatim; no assumed metric production for partial ingestion.
Intentional no-arrival minute had no returned Default point during the complete query window; this is bounded absence consistent with docs, not an eternal nonpublication guarantee.
Cross-subscription/metric regex quota, long-horizon delivery, negative/scientific numeric values, and centralized @source.log publication were not measured.
